public class DirectMessagingActivity extends androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity implements MessageAdapter.MessageActions
Activity responsible for handling direct messages and group messages. Provides WebSocket real time communication, file sending, reply threading, message reactions, and member management for group chats.
Author:
Ji Xian Fu
